beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: A 1% fee. Guess what it costs in 40 years.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Pocket change! Fine, three checkpoints. Lock your guess in before the last flag.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Two friends each invest $500 a month at an assumed 7%. One of them pays the fee. After 10 years, the gap is $4,698.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Told you. Tiny. Now 20 years... $29,807? That's real money!

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: At 30 years, the gap is $108,775. Still guessing low?

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Here's why. The fee doesn't just take its slice each year. Everything it takes would have grown, for decades. That's the cost nobody sees.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: The last flag, 40 years. The friend with no fee ends up with $1.3M. With the fee, just $1.0M.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: So that 1% fee cost $319,338. Was your guess anywhere close?

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Okay, my turn. Here's one for you.
